reserves.name: Market-neutral spot collateral, perpetual hedges, and stability reserve
reserves.issuerOrObligor: StandX protocol, custodians, and undisclosed centralized-exchange counterparties

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: StandX architecture, minting, risks/hedging, redemption, and product-FAQ pages still describe DUSD as market-neutral / delta-neutral — USDT/USDC mint inputs converted into spot crypto (examples include ETH, SOL, BTC) with matching short perpetual hedges plus a stability/RSV reserve fund for negative funding — without any dated balance sheet, component weights, venue inventory, or Stability Reserve Fund size. Product FAQ points users to the website for a 'reserve ratio' but the public dashboard and overview pages return no itemized composition, PoR, or attestation. Independently, DefiLlama classifies StandX DUSD as pegMechanism crypto-backed with mint/redeem via USDT/USDC and publishes circulating supply only (no reserve breakdown). No public API on api.standx.com, perps.standx.com, or ice.standx.com exposes reserve composition. Therefore the prior fabricated 50/45/5 split remains rejected; the narrowest source-supported row is the 100% aggregate market-neutral envelope with knownUnknownExposurePct 100.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: StandX architecture, minting, hedging, redemption, and product-FAQ documentation re-opened 2026-07-28; component weights remain undisclosed; DefiLlama corroborates crypto-backed peg without a reserve breakdown
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current reserve weights, exact spot constituents, exchange counterparties, custodian shares, and the Stability Reserve Fund composition are not disclosed in the reviewed primary sources or independent catalogs.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Primary docs and independent DefiLlama catalog document the delta-neutral reserve mechanism but do not publish current component weights or venue allocations, so the aggregate cannot be split or linked without fabrication.

providers.name: Ceffu and centralized exchange custody partners

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: StandX documents multi-signature custody solutions, exchange-diversified hedging, and custodial insurance coverage, and issuer materials reference Ceffu custody, but the reviewed sources do not publish provider shares, account segregation, insolvency treatment, or rehypothecation terms.
